description: Approved test matrix (OpenSpec refactor-microservices-monorepo 1.59). Consumed by 3.x CI workflows.

feature_push.notes: Affected product service unit tests only (per service, via detect_changes.py). No integration, contract, E2E, sandbox, GPU, or benchmark work. Service pytest config ignores tests/integration and tests/contract by default.

pull_request.notes: Affected unit + integration + contract suites with branch coverage --cov-fail-under=80 (per-service [tool.coverage.report] fail_under = 80), then cached container build/validation.

merge.notes: Merge commits run the same gate as pull requests against the exact merge commit.

release.notes: Release verification adds affected cross-service E2E from tests/e2e (live stack required; missing stack fails loudly).

sandbox.reason: Real hosted-provider checks (LiveAvatar, hosted LLM/TTS). Never in ordinary CI; authorized operators select them explicitly and missing credentials fail loudly.

hosted_provider.reason: Live provider integration; explicit authorized jobs only.

gpu.reason: GPU inference runs only in authorized staging smoke jobs.

benchmark.reason: Performance programs never masquerade as correctness tests; explicit staging/manual work.
